howToPlay: Lola controls multiple lanes by utilizing her Ego. Use the Freeze Frame gadget for defense or Stunt Double to heal and reposition while managing your distance to maximize damage output.
gears: Equip Damage to capitalize on the Improvise star power, and Reload Speed to ensure consistent pressure with her basic attacks.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy strategic positioning and managing multiple points of impact on the battlefield.
